title: Accessible organization access workspace
scope: Organization switcher, project resource search, member detail, grant editor, invitations, audit, and migration review views.
Generated API types, tenant/principal-aware query keys, confirmed mutations, and stable URL state.
excluded: Authority enforced only by hidden UI controls
invariants: Switching account clears prior account protected data and pending selections.
Denied resource cannot be rendered from a previous tenant cache.
Form input survives recoverable failures; stale version requires review.
Status uses text in addition to color.

acceptance.given: A user opens organization A and switches to B
acceptance.then: A data never renders under B; principal/org/project are present in query keys

acceptance.given: The resource panel fails but organization metadata loads
acceptance.then: recoverable panel error and unaffected valid panels remain usable

acceptance.given: Another operator changes grants before submit
acceptance.then: UI preserves the draft, fetches current state, shows the conflict, and never displays unconfirmed access

acceptance.given: An operator uses only keyboard at 375, 768, and 1440 widths
acceptance.when: the invitation and grant journey runs
acceptance.then: controls have labels, visible focus, usable dialogs, and no horizontal loss of actions
acceptance.evidence: browser journey plus accessibility scan and manual keyboard evidence

acceptance.given: An invitation expires or delivery fails
acceptance.then: recipient state and delivery state remain distinct with an actionable explanation

acceptance.given: An unresolved migration conflict has competing evidence
acceptance.then: source/target difference and required owner decision are visible; UI cannot bypass cutover gate
